visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a white paper cup filled with ice and dark pearls. A brownish milk tea is being poured from a pitcher into the cup, partially submerging the ice. The background is a dark, metallic kitchen surface. (2) The camera cuts to a cup topped with a generous amount of brown flour tea powder. A hand rotates the cup to show the corgi logo and QR codes on the side. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A metal slotted spoon scoops translucent, jelly-like pearls from a pot of syrup. The camera then cuts to another spoon lifting glossy dark tapioca pearls. The setting is an indoor commercial kitchen. (4) A female shop assistant wearing a white face mask and a blue apron with a logo stands behind a counter. She carefully places four milk tea cups into a clear plastic bag, lifts the bag, and looks towards the camera. (5) An outdoor shot shows the white store sign 'Finding Hope 希望奶茶' against a blue and wooden storefront. It transitions back to the woman holding the bag in a brightly lit indoor space. (6) Close-up shots show two blue and white cups side-by-side, featuring an illustration of a corgi dog. Hands hold the cups up for display. (7) A montage shows various drink preparation steps: white milk being poured into a cup, pearls being added with a spoon, and more brown powder being dusted onto the surface of a drink. (8) A spoon scoops thick purple rice and taro paste onto a drink topped with white milk foam. Another cup features chocolate milk being poured over ice cubes. (9) A white milk foam layer is poured over a chocolate-colored drink with crushed Oreo cookies. The camera then shows yellow fruit tea being poured and topped with orange grapefruit pulp. (10) Three cups are lined up on a wooden counter. A hand reaches out to touch one of the cups. The final shot displays the store's blue sign and detailed address information overlay.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Presentation -> Variety Showcase -> Store Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the opening of a new branch of 'Finding Hope' milk tea shop in Kaohsiung and to highlight their free topping offer and unique drink menu items like Miancha and Purple Rice Taro Milk.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the shop, shows the location address, and provides a favorable review of the products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-frequency cuts and vibrant close-ups of food preparation to create a 'mouth-watering' effect typical of social media food blogging. The inclusion of the corgi branding adds a 'cute' appeal.
